name: Tony Riches
headline: Independent ERP Assurance Review: 15 working days to tell the board whether the programme is genuinely ready for UAT, go-live or recovery. Oh, and a bit of writing too...
about:
With thirty years of ERP experience - initially as a victim and then 26 years in Programme Management Project Director and Assurance roles, my main focus having been the delivery of ERP, CRM and AI enabled business transformation programmes from solution specification to handover into support. Genuinely globally experienced, having worked on all five habitable continents, and with SAP, D365, Oracle and JDE under my belt, I am now working as an independent ERP programme assurance consultant. I have a proven ability to diagnose delivery issues, recommend solutions that I know will work and to get your major project back on track. With 15 years in delivery consultancy I am also adept at dealing with consultancy partners in a robust but collaborative manner to ensure delivery of the contractual promise. 

Specialities: Programme Assurance, Programme Management, Change Management, Project Rescue and Project and Programme Management mentoring, on a full or part time basis.

Please follow the link to view a programme rescue case study and ERP Success Factors presentation.

https://aquilaerp.com/

experiences.description: I am a Transformation Project Director and Assurance Consultant with an ERP specialisation, with 25 years of experience of the good, the bad and the ugly, providing consultancy and project assurance services through Aquila ERP Consulting. I've managed the specification, solution selection and delivery of ERP and CRM solutions using waterfall, Agile and combined methodologies, and across a range of organisations from custom engineering to central government, Want to know if your transformation project is going to be successful? I can tell  you, and if there are problems I can show you how to/help you make them go away. My experience base ranges from 'small' businesses (for major projects, that is, with circa £250m turnover) to major enterprises and government departments delivering both ERP and Power Platform projects.
Project directed major client engagements in the Healthcare and Datacentre industries, working on both D365 and M365 projects with AI components.

Providing Hitachi Solutions clients with QA and delivery assurance of their D365 ERP and CRM business system transformation programmes, managing multiple Project Managers to ensure their success. Highlights among twenty projects directed include a £50m ERP solution delivery to the Department of Health and working with the HMRC Valuation Office Agency to delivery new solutions and ways of working in the CE/Power Platform space.
Managed a four month project to help Stadco choose the right ERP solution and vendor for their needs..
Worked as a global programme assurance and remediation director for Infor, a major US ERP software vendor and services provider.

experiences.position: ERP Programme Director Microsoft Dynamics AX
experiences.description:
Partner in a bespoke ERP delivery consultancy, providing services to global clients. Highlights were:

- Microsoft Dynamics AX programme management in the USA (10 month contract)
- Microsoft Dynamics AX programme management and resourcing for a major City trading company.

experiences.position: ERP Programme Director Microsoft Dynamics AX
experiences.description: As Interim Programme Director, responsible for the delivery of a global Microsoft Dynamics AX ERP solution as Programme Director for Howden Group's Project Enterprise in the UK, Germany, France and China.

Time working with Organon (now part of Schering Plough) was very enjoyable, encompassing the start up of an SAP project intended to operate across the global Organon business. Working with some truly excellent people, I learned lots about this important phase of the project - I've tended to perform project ERP rescues in the past, and therefore never had time to worry about the niceties of scoping and initiation. I left when SP took Organon over, since the project was clearly going to be significantly delayed, but we completed the initiation phase and I personally learned a lot and made some great new contacts.
Provided consultancy services to GSK in the areas of  PMO and Offshoring

Reporting to the corporate IT Director, I reinvigorated and took to the point of Pilot Go Live a major (£45m) ERP build and implement programme. This was closed down in favour of a different application suite on the company being acquired by St Gobain.
